verdict.rationale: Fastmail's JMAP API batches work: a client can POST a `methodCalls` array so a query, fetch and send all run in one HTTP request. That is a programmatic route to acting on many items in one round trip. Nothing in the evidence shows multi-item update, move or delete calls, or bulk selection in the web UI. One community report says filters don't apply to existing emails, which limits retroactive bulk organisation. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/move/delete across many messages, bulk-selection UI actions, documented limits for batch size, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
A single HTTP roundtrip is often all that's required.
The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
